item.title: Gardai attend early morning incident in Letterkenny
item.description: Gardaí have confirmed they were were called to an incident in a premises in Letterkenny shortly after 3:30 this morning. They say the Armed Support Unit was in attendance, but a less than lethal force option was deployed, and the incident was resolved. No further details have been released.
